title: Collections and Data Handling
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of collections and data handling in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 5: Collections and Data Handling. Lessons in order: Introduction to Swift Collections; Arrays in Swift; Array Operations; Array Slicing and Indices; Sets in Swift; Set Operations; Dictionaries in Swift; Dictionary Operations; Ranges and Collection Sequences; Higher-Order Collection Operations.
